control.detail: The route chooses it: src/presentation/new-game.ts:220 sets v2 for a new game, and src/presentation/production-world.ts:228 falls back to v1 when a caller passes none.

producers.reachDetail: The ordinary New Game route sets given-name-v2; every walked life in this project starts here.
Defaults to given-name-v1 when givenNameGenerationVersion is omitted. Which callers omit it, and whether a player reaches one, is not walked.

duplication.visibilityDetail: Only the code can see which algorithm ran; a player sees names, not versions.

measurements.found: new-game.ts sets v2; production-world.ts defaults to v1; new-game-identity.ts accepts both on load.
measurements.what: Every non-test reference to the given-name generation version

playerReachDetail: Which entry points a player can reach that take the v1 fallback has not been walked.

surface.detail: Nothing on screen says which one a world was made with.

system.detail: Two given-name generation versions in src/simulation/people.ts: given-name-v1 (LEGACY) and given-name-v2 (DISTINCT).
